segments.text:
V. 8.
Repentance is of two Sorts; that which is termed legal, and that which is ſtiled evangelicat Repentance. The former (which is the ſame that is ſpoken of here) is, A thorough Conviction of Sin. The latter is, A Change of Heart (and conſequently of Life) from all Sin to all Holineſs.
